title: Mixing: The Mess by Wings | 1972
content:
Control Room Four, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Wings’ song ‘The Mess’ was mixed in stereo on 11 December 1972.

This was the first of three consecutive mixing days for the Red Rose Speedway album, which also saw work done on ‘One More Kiss’ and ‘Mama’s Little Girl’. Only one of the songs made it onto the album.

Seven stereo mixes of ‘The Mess’ were made, with the last marked “best so far”. The song was earmarked for a planned double album edition, but was left off the final release.
